name: Rin'ji's Secret
summary: After helping Rin'ji, you carry a tablet etched with Witherbark troll markings that nobody has yet read. Oran Snakewrithe, who studies the Witherbark, might decipher it, and lives in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

sections.title: A Tablet Nobody Can Read
sections.body: Witherbark troll markings cover the tablet, and what Rin'ji's secret really is remains a mystery. It might be worth a great deal, or it might be worth nothing, because a Witherbark troll in trouble would probably do anything to get out of it.

sections.title: A Scholar in the Undercity
sections.body: Oran Snakewrithe is a well-known scholar of the Witherbark trolls, known to live in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Oran might be able to read the tablet.

faq.q: Where did this tablet come from?
aliases: how do i get the tablet
faq.answer: It is the secret Rin'ji hid at the Overlook Cliffs, found after helping Rin'ji escape from Quel'Danil Lodge.

faq.q: Who can read the markings on the tablet?
faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe, a scholar who knows the Witherbark trolls well, may be able to decipher it.
Oran is known to live in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
Nobody can say. It may be worth a lot or nothing, since a Witherbark troll in distress might try anything to escape trouble.
